target.name: MIND Phase 2 associative disclosure plus Exoframe cooperative delivery seam

exact cosine-radius union, exhaustive lexical membership, one-hop bridges, false-friend boundaries, and canonical or compact membership-conserving rendering
privacy filtering, generation replay, activation ordering, currentness, field-bound card expansion, and query-only H0 service behavior
Exoframe validated transient developer-context construction before adapter dispatch, exact renderer preservation, and safe-mode denial before state mutation
regression behavior in the two repository source trees
excluded: live Codex Desktop event interception or dynamic pre-turn context-provider integration
observed event ingestion, live embedding generation, authenticated provider dispatch, provider receipt, and complete H1 correlation
utility ranking, top-K recommendation, automatic tool activation, action authorization, or result interception

wheel construction, fresh-host installation, release, push, publication, and public-distribution readiness

impact_map: Filtering private capabilities after comparison, counting, errors, or diagnostics could disclose hidden existence without returning a handle.
A profile, timestamp, revision, replay, or concurrent-write fork could split the supposedly complete global capability generation.
Top-K, fusion, or utility ranking could hide serendipitously relevant capabilities and invert the reminder-field purpose.
Canonical and compact representations could silently disagree on membership.
A mutable or weakly bound delivery envelope could inject text from a different field, snapshot, estate, or membership generation.
Persisting transient reminder material could contaminate conversation continuity or disclose private capability context.
Safe-mode rejection after flow or ledger mutation could create denied-turn side effects.
A local rendered-payload capture could be mislabeled as live H1 delivery.

invariants.statement: Visibility filtering precedes comparison, currentness, errors, counts, and diagnostics on every query and expansion route.
Every activation strictly advances one complete global successor generation across embedding profiles and commits atomically.
Membership is an unordered union of exact-radius, exhaustive lexical, and explicit one-hop association paths; no utility score, top-K, fusion rank, recommendation, or action authority is emitted.
Canonical and compact forms carry every same handle and bind one membership-manifest digest.
One portable envelope binds exact field bytes, field, snapshot, scoped estate, membership, mode, and representation.
A validated field is appended exactly once after transcript loading, before rendering and dispatch, and is absent from persistent messages, turns, events, and later continuations.
MIND service responses remain H0 and local adapter capture is described only as pre-sampling construction, not live H1.

risks.statement: Private capability existence leaks through comparison, diagnostics, counts, stale status, or card expansion.
An alternate profile, equal or backdated activation, stale revision, replay, or concurrent writer forks or partially mutates the global generation.
Ranking-shaped retrieval, boundary instability, or row-order dependence changes reminder membership or hides relevant handles.
Canonical and compact forms, expansion tokens, or the delivery envelope accept mismatched membership or altered bytes.
Exoframe persists, duplicates, resurrects, or safe-mode-mutates around transient reminder material.
Development evidence is generalized into an automatic H1, provider, fresh-host, package, or release claim.
A sandbox-only Windows Credential Manager failure is misclassified as a product regression or silently ignored.

scenarios.title: Private scope is filtered before every observable query consequence
preconditions: Public and exact-agent-private capabilities, snapshots, revisions, and query tokens exist.
action: Query public-only, correct-owner, wrong-owner, stale, and zero-visible private states; request member and nonmember card expansions.
expected: Only entitled handles and projections are compared or returned; hidden-only state produces generic count-free results; unauthorized expansion has no disclosure.
forbidden: Private handles, aliases, counts, detailed foreign-key diagnostics, drift, or existence signals crossing scope.

scenarios.title: One complete globally ordered generation survives replay and competing paths
preconditions: Multiple card revisions and embedding profiles exist.
action: Attempt equal-time, backdated, partial, stale-revision, changed-replay, alternate-profile, and concurrent-writer activations.
expected: Invalid successors reject before commit; exact replay is stable; the database remains byte-for-byte unchanged after rejected forks.
forbidden: Partial activation, profile-local bypass, stale currentness, duplicate effect, or mutation outside the transaction.

scenarios.title: Arm's Reach returns deterministic nearby membership rather than ranked recommendations
preconditions: Fixed vector and lexical profiles, multiple anchors, bridges, and false-friend relations exist.
action: Exercise radius boundaries, lexical aliases, multiple anchors, row reordering, bridges, boundaries, and vector-unavailable degradation.
expected: Membership is the deterministic union; correction anchors add without erasing task anchors; false-friend public rendering hides positive paths while retaining audit provenance.
forbidden: Top-K truncation, rank or score fields, anchor collapse, unstable ordering, or vector claims in lexical-only mode.

scenarios.title: Exact representation and envelope bytes remain bound end to end
preconditions: A valid MIND field and both representations exist.
action: Compare memberships and alter text, length, body hash, membership digest, delivery digest, or add an unknown field.
expected: Canonical and compact memberships match; every altered or extra envelope form rejects before host admission.
forbidden: Silent truncation, unbound representation changes, permissive extra fields, or a field from another snapshot.

scenarios.title: Validated reminder text is exact, transient, and denied before mutation in safe mode
preconditions: Exoframe normal and safe modes and supported renderers are available.
action: Begin normal turns with a compiled field, inspect adapter inputs and storage, continue without resupply, and submit a field in safe mode.
expected: Exactly one final developer instruction reaches each renderer unchanged; storage and continuation omit it; safe mode leaves flows, messages, turns, and adapter calls unchanged.
forbidden: Persistence, duplication, resurrection, reordering, truncation, or denied-turn mutation.

scenarios.title: Local construction evidence does not become a live delivery claim
preconditions: MIND and Exoframe local tests pass.
action: Inspect service status, envelope documentation, work packet, capture point, and omitted live boundaries.
expected: MIND reports H0 and documentation explicitly requires event ingest, same-turn compilation, correlation, authenticated delivery, and receipt for H1.
forbidden: Calling local rendered-payload capture H1 or claiming Codex Desktop interception, provider receipt, installation, or release readiness.

scenarios.title: Win32 logon-session failure is separated from product behavior
preconditions: The sandboxed process returns CredWriteW error 1312.
action: Preserve the red full-suite receipt, identify the Windows message, rerun only the two same cases through the authorized host channel, and run every other case hermetically.
expected: The same two cases pass with a usable host logon session; the remaining 125 pass in the sandbox.
forbidden: Editing product code, suppressing the red receipt, calling the failure a flake, or treating host success as proof of unrelated boundaries.

findings.statement: Earlier activation logic allowed profile-local or partial successor generations to bypass a globally complete capability baseline.
findings.next_action: Retain the global activation clock, complete-successor validation, transaction boundary, and equal/backdated alternate-profile regression.

findings.statement: The sandboxed Exoframe test process had no usable Windows Credential Manager logon session and returned Win32 error 1312.
findings.next_action: Keep platform tests on the qualified host channel and retain the red sandbox receipt beside the discriminating pass.

findings.statement: TestForge's heuristic smell scanner treats the domain word snapshot as a snapshot-assertion smell and emits 112 low-severity false positives.
findings.next_action: Do not convert heuristic hits into product findings; improve token-context discrimination in a separately scoped TestForge change.

findings.statement: Command-record normalization preserves exit status but does not parse unittest or pytest output into per-case counts.
findings.next_action: Use raw unittest custody and JUnit for pytest counts; improve command-output parsing in a separately scoped TestForge change.

findings.statement: The first portable contract vector captured a field ID derived from a randomly issued session capability, so the supposedly stable vector changed on every construction.
findings.next_action: Retain the fixed contract-only field identity, producer regeneration assertion, vendored consumer vector, and cross-repository byte-identity receipt.

residual_risks.statement: No live H1 event-ingest, same-turn compilation, authenticated provider delivery, correlation, or receipt chain has been observed.
residual_risks.treatment: Keep MIND at H0 and Exoframe at local pre-sampling construction until a separately authorized live acceptance.
residual_risks.revisit_condition: before any automatic-delivery or H1 claim

residual_risks.statement: No production embedding model or calibrated profile was qualified on this host.
residual_risks.treatment: Use explicit lexical degradation or qualify an immutable embedding profile before vector-backed runtime use.

residual_risks.statement: Wheel construction, fresh-host installation, and public distribution remain unexecuted.
residual_risks.treatment: Run separate packaging, fresh-host, documentation, and release gates before distribution.

residual_risks.statement: TestForge smell and command-record normalization heuristics produced known low-severity evidence noise.
residual_risks.treatment: Preserve the raw receipts and keep the tooling fixes in a separate bounded TestForge change.
residual_risks.revisit_condition: before relying on those heuristics as autonomous gates
